description: Fetch the full transcript plus metadata (title, channel, duration) for any YouTube video. Accepts a watch, youtu.be, Shorts, or mobile URL, or a raw video ID. No LLM: returns the raw caption text for downstream summarization or repurposing. Same result as POST /api/v1/youtube/transcript. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

url.description: A YouTube URL (watch / youtu.be / shorts / mobile) or a raw 11-char video ID.

name: get_youtube_transcript
title: Get YouTube transcript
